sources.title: Progressive July 2026 results
sources.supports: Latest premiums, ratio, income and policies

financial_anchor.caveat: Calculated as earned premiums × (1-combined ratio); excludes investment income and normalization

ai_claim.claim: Snapshot telematics is deployed in pricing, while digital claim workflows support automation.
ai_claim.limitation: No current-model matched cohort or cash bridge

strongest_counterevidence.claim: Excellent ratios are heavily confounded by rate adequacy, mix, weather and reserves; July ratio worsened year over year.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Monthly volatility does not disprove algorithm quality

rights_limit: Driving and claim data are customer/third-party-originated and purpose-bound; programme consent does not prove unrestricted cross-customer reuse. A defensible review must identify owner, permitted purpose, geography, retention/deletion, model-improvement permission and audit rights for each decisive dataset; public product access alone closes none of those questions.
materiality_summary: 5% of a $10.535bn underwriting-profit proxy is $526.8m, equivalent to about 64.5bp of FY2025 earned premium.
g2_provisional: Limited: production telematics exists, but incremental AI loss/expense lift and retained economics are not disclosed. Product availability or management-described use supports E1/E2 only. G2 requires an eligible-workload denominator, frozen model/version, matched quality-adjusted comparator, full implementation and inference cost, and a reconciliation to recognized revenue, displaced spend, avoided hiring or released capital. Those elements were not found together in the public materials reviewed through the cutoff.
unresolved_questions: What consent and reuse rights apply?
